doctor.name: Dr. Hadi Raza
doctor.title: Dermatology & Dental Surgery Specialist
doctor.shortBio: Dr. Hadi Raza brings a rare combination of expertise in both dermatology and dental surgery, offering comprehensive facial aesthetic care under one roof. With 3–5 years of dedicated clinical experience, he has transformed hundreds of lives across Purnea and Banmankhi.
doctor.longBio:
Growing up in Bihar, Dr. Hadi Raza witnessed firsthand how limited access to quality dermatological and dental care affected the confidence and wellbeing of people in his community. Skin conditions went untreated. Smiles were left unrepaired. That early experience planted the seed for a lifelong mission.

After completing his MBBS, Dr. Raza pursued advanced specialized training in dermatology and dental surgery, studying the intersection of science and aesthetics that defines modern facial medicine. He trained under leading practitioners and immersed himself in the latest laser technologies, cosmetic procedures, and restorative dental techniques.

Returning to Bihar, he established Dent-O-Facial with a singular vision: to bring premium, world-class skin and dental care to Purnea and Banmankhi — without requiring patients to travel to distant metros.
doctor.quote: My goal is simple: when a patient walks out of my clinic, they should feel more confident, more beautiful, and completely taken care of.
